title: ICS at GRC Conference and Show
text: October 23 – 26, 2011, ICS exhibited at the Geothermal Resources Council (GRC) show in San Diego, California. ICS is a member of GRC and very active in the global geothermal cooling business. The show was the best attended GRC show on record and ICS is proud to be an active member of GRC.
